items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: In that band they had a guy named ... Anderson, Big Anderson, playing trumpet. And ... I was playing piano

ctx.x: He played some French songs. He played some French songs. In that band they had a guy named Cyril with saxophone, and Roy Evans, who's a drum, Willie O'Connor, guitar. I was playing piano, and Anderson, Big Anderson, playing trumpet. And Sam Lee was a tennis player. He was a tennis player. He was a big Anderson. Andy, yeah. Andy, yeah, Big Anderson. He's not big anymore. No. He's smaller.

He's getting smaller. He used to be fat, huh? Yeah. I think after he had his car accident in the last couple of weeks. I didn't know that, you see. Yeah, he's not big anymore. He's a big guy, and I was working with him. It's funny they call him big, and I can't even think who you mean because he's small now.
